description:
A customer, 'Alfreds Futterkiste', has gone into liquidation and their outstanding invoice 'INV-BAD-001' for 500.00 is uncollectible. You need to write off this bad debt.

1. Go to Settings > Chart of Accounts and create a new Expense account named 'Bad Debts'.
2. Go to Credit Notes and create a new credit note for 'Alfreds Futterkiste' dated today.
3. In the credit note, allocate the 500.00 amount specifically to the 'Bad Debts' expense account you just created (do NOT leave it as the default Sales account).
4. Use 'Write off uncollectible invoice' as the description and save.
